quest.title: Emergency Supplies
quest.description: Riese is preparing emergency supplies to protect some reckless adventurers from getting in trouble on Dragonspine...

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: Traveler! Wonderful timing. Could you do me a favor?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you need?

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: As you've no doubt seen, the conditions up here are horrendous. Even experienced adventurers would not dare to claim that they can handle all that Dragonspine can throw at them.

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: I have orders from the Acting Grand Master to stand guard here and warn all citizens not to go up the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: However, while I have been able to persuade many citizens not to do so, those adventurers...

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: I'm sure you know what I mean when I say that there's no use trying to convince them. They just want to go up that mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: I've lost count of the number of matters I've had to resolve involving the adventurers... But they just keep coming anyway, and their ranks never thin.

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: Trying to manage them all is an impossible task... As such, I've decided to prepare some supplies for them in designated spots on Dragonspine.

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: In this way, those adventurers who have suffered a reverse and are preparing to turn back will have more opportunities to extricate themselves from the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: However, if some reckless fool drunk on their good fortune were to get too far up, then they'd only have themselves to rely on...

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: So, could you help bring these supplies up the mountain?

response.speaker: Riese
response.text: I shall be counting on you, then. *sigh* If only those adventurers had as good a sword-arm and as sensible a head on their shoulders as you do...

response.speaker: Riese
response.text: I've marked three locations out on your map. You simply have to place <color=#00E1FFFF>one serving of Ham</color> at each place.

response.speaker: Riese
response.text: *sigh* I wish those adventurers had a little more self-awareness...

choices.text: Will they be of any use?

response.speaker: Riese
response.text: Whether they will or not... It's better to have them than not.

response.speaker: Riese
response.text: In such terrible conditions as the ones we have on this mountain, the more supplies we have, the better. All told, I'm counting on your help.

talks.objective: Place the food supplies at the first location

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: Have you placed all the supplies?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They're all where they need to be.

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: That's wonderful. I can rest easy now.

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: Still, I hope that those who go up the mountain will come sufficiently prepared and that they shan't have to use these emergency foodstuffs.

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, your clothes seem a little thin, too. Is this the latest fashion in Mondstadt or something?

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, please take these as a token of my thanks, and go put on some extra layers.

talks.objective: Place the food supplies at the second location

dialogues.speaker: Emergency Supply Point
dialogues.text: This is an emergency supply point. If you should need anything, you may help yourself to the materials here.

dialogues.speaker: Emergency Supply Point
dialogues.text: Dragonspine is a dangerous place. Please do not go too far in.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Place Supplies
